2 turns (12 stacks max). [Apathy] decreases the chance to deal a critical hit of all afflicted targets by 5% for each stack they are afflicted with.
Additionally, after the decision to inflict [Apathy] has been made, if a target is enhanced with [Increased Chance to Deal a Critical Hit], the stack count of [Apathy] on that target increases by 1.
When Fia or an ally is inflicted with a debuff from an active skill, additionally, before inflicting [Apathy], dispels 1 debuff from Fia.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Dissociation. The targets of the magical attack become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens An Oppressed Gift. The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 1000% of Myrlennia’s ATK.
Strengthens Dissociation. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK.

levels.text:
The light Myrlennia shines dissociates all magic compounds it touches, splitting them apart to obstruct any magical interference from the enemy. Deals
1 magical attack equal to 130% of Myrlennia’s ATK to
3 random enemies. Before dealing the magical attack, this skill inflicts on all targets 1 stack of a debuff that decreases their M. DEF by 5% for 5 turns (8 stacks max).

Additionally, after the decision to inflict [Decreased M. DEF] has been made, if this skill activates for the
3rd time and onward during battle, the stack count of [Decreased M. DEF] inflicted on all targets by this skill increases by 2.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 400% of her ATK.

A ray of converged light shoots out from Myrlennia’s staff, piercing through everything in its path. Deals
7 magical attacks equal to 420% of Myrlennia’s ATK to the enemy with the lowest M. DEF.
Additionally, if this skill activates for the 3rd time and onward during battle, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 630% of her ATK.
Additionally, if this skill activates for the 4th time and onward during battle, the magical attacks’ damage becomes equal to 840% of her ATK.
If this skill activates for the 4th time and onward during battle, additionally, the attacks ignore [Shield] if the target is enhanced with it.

To escape reality, a young Myrlennia played with fairies only she could see. Even now, she has yet to realize it is but a fraction of the power her extraordinary gift bears... At the start of each turn, this skill grants 1 stack of [Fairies] to Myrlennia (30 stacks max) (cannot be dispelled). [Fairies] increases Myrlennia’s ATK by 3% and M. DEF by 5% for each stack she is enhanced with.

Additionally, at the start of the turn, grants Myrlennia [Shield] equal to 200% of her ATK for 4 turns. The effect that grants [Shield] will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation, and will not activate from the 13th turn and onward.
Additionally, if there are 2 or more Amber Soul allies other than Myrlennia in the party, the number of stacks of [Fairies] granted by this skill becomes 2.

“Th-Thanks to the others, I started to smile, just a little... S-So, this time, it’s my turn to do what I can for them...!” At the start of the turn, this skill decreases the damage Myrlennia takes by 10%, and increases her DEF by 30% for 4 turns. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.
The amount her DEF increases by becomes 150%.
The decrease in damage she takes becomes 30%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Tempesta Àvida. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens My Treasure. The amount the target’s max HP increases by becomes 50%.
Strengthens Tempesta Àvida. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 480% of her ATK.

levels.text: “Pray forgive me!” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 240% of Regina’s ATK to 3 random enemies.

Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, increases the damage all targets take by 10% for 4 turns. If a target’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it is lower than Regina’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it, the increase in damage that target takes becomes 30%.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 440% of her ATK.
“Bow before my elegance!” Deals 1 physical attack equal to 620% of Regina’s ATK to the 2 enemies with the highest ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 920% of her ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1520% of her ATK.

Additionally, if a target’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it is lower than Regina’s ATK before any stat increases or decreases were applied to it, the physical attack’s damage to that target becomes equal to 2280% of her ATK.

“‘I’ll’ give you anything—no, everything I have. Just please...save my ‘---’...!” At the start of the battle, this skill grants 6 stacks of [Memory’s Remnant] to Regina (cannot be dispelled). [Memory’s Remnant] increases Regina’s chance to deal a critical hit by 3% for each stack she is enhanced with. At the start of each turn, if Regina is enhanced with [Memory’s Remnant], the stack count of her [Memory’s Remnant] is depleted by 1, and this skill increases the ATK of the 2 allies with the highest ATK by 15% for 1 turn.
The amount all targets’ ATK increases by becomes 30%.

The number of stacks of [Memory’s Remnant] granted by this skill becomes 10. Additionally, at the start of the 3rd turn, if the total number of critical hits dealt by Regina and her allies’ attacks during battle is
5 or more, the stack count of Regina’s [Memory’s Remnant] is depleted by 4, and this skill decreases the skill cooldown time of the ally with the highest ATK by 2.

“Their name and face escape me... All I remember is...that they were precious to me—” When Regina is attacked, the attack’s damage is cut by 20%. If Regina is enhanced with [Memory’s Remnant], the amount the damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by becomes 40%.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, increases the max HP of the ally with the highest ATK by 25% (cannot be dispelled).
The amount the damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by becomes 60%. If Regina is enhanced with [Memory’s Remnant], the amount the damage from the enemy’s attack is cut by becomes 75%.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Lazy Lock-Up. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens Indolent Black Hare. The decrease in damage she takes becomes 70%.
Strengthens Lazy Lock-Up. The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 360% of her ATK.

levels.text:
“Alright guys, simmer down. If any one of you even tries to act like a fidgety ferret, I’m gonna lock you right up!” Deals 1 magical attack equal to 240% of Trixie’s ATK to
3 random enemies, and has a 70% chance to decrease all targets’ SPD by 20% for 2 turns.
Additionally, if a target’s MAG is lower than Trixie’s MAG, the number of turns of [Decreased SPD] on that target becomes 5.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 330% of her ATK.

“Hey, have you heard? Word is, procrastination is contagious~ So, um, if you actually do catch something from me... My bad?” Deals 1 magical attack equal to 260% of Trixie’s ATK to 4 random enemies. Afterwards, this skill has a 70% chance to inflict [Fainted] on the enemy with the highest ATK for 1 turn.
The magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 380% of her ATK.
After dealing the magical attack, additionally, if the number of buffs Trixie is enhanced with is 4 or more, the number of turns of [Fainted] becomes 2.
Additionally, if this skill activates for the 3rd time and onwards during battle, the magical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1520% of her ATK.

“I’m busier than a bee? Quite the opposite, actually.
I knock out all the preparations first so I can kick back and relax later!” At the start of the 1st turn, this skill grants Trixie [Shield] equal to 100% of her ATK for
10 turns. If an enemy is enhanced with [Debuff Immunity] or [Unhindered], the targets who are granted [Shield] become all allies.
Additionally, at the start of the battle, decreases the damage she takes by 10% (cannot be dispelled).

The size of [Shield] becomes equal to 200% of her ATK. Additionally, if a target who is granted [Shield] is an Amber Soul ally, the size of that target’s [Shield] becomes equal to 500% of Trixie’s ATK.

“I promised you I’d stick around and watch how everything plays out, yeah...? Kind of a problem for me,
if I’m being honest. But, until we reach the end of our journey, I’ll help out. Just a teeny-weeny bit...alright?”
At the start of Trixie’s action phase, this skill increases her DEF by 20% and chance to hit by 30% for 4 turns. This skill will not activate again until 4 action phases have ended since its previous activation.

At the start of Trixie’s action phase, additionally, if the number of Amber Soul allies other than Trixie in the party is 2 or more, increases her HP Drain by 20%
for 4 turns.
The amount her DEF increases by becomes 100%.

members.name: The Witch of Lamented Spirits · Elaine

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Maddening Whisper. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.

Strengthens Witch of Lamented Spirits. The amount all targets’ DEF increases by becomes 80%. The amount all targets’ M. DEF increases by becomes 40%. The amount all targets’ M. CRIT DMG Cut increases by becomes 20%.
Strengthens Maddening Whisper. The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 240% of her ATK.

levels.text:
A sweet, soothing whisper from Elaine is all it takes to drive any spirit into madness, plunging them into a darkness where only their lamentations remain. Deals
1 physical attack equal to 220% of her ATK to 3 random enemies, and has a 40% chance to decrease all targets’ chance to inflict a debuff by 15% for 4 turns.
The chance to inflict [Decreased Chance to Inflict a Debuff] becomes 70%.
The decrease in all targets’ chance to inflict a debuff becomes 30%.

The spirit is what makes the person. Thus, losing one’s spirit is tantamount to losing one’s very existence.
Deals 1 physical attack equal to 720% of Elaine’s ATK to
2 random enemies.
The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1320% of her ATK.
Additionally, before dealing the physical attack, if Elaine is enhanced with [Spirit Brand], the physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 1980% of her ATK.

There was a time when her holy prayer healed even the festering decay that Curses wrought upon the human body. But now...it has been corrupted into a witch’s wish—one that allows her to defile any spirit of her choosing. If Elaine or an ally is attacked, remains alive with a remaining HP percentage of 30% or lower, and is not enhanced with [Spirit Brand], this skill dispels 2 debuffs from that attacked ally, restores HP equal to 100% of Elaine’s ATK to them, and grants [Spirit Brand] to them (cannot be dispelled). If Elaine is defeated by the attack, this skill’s effect that dispels debuffs from the attacked ally, restores HP to them, and grants [Spirit Brand] to them will not activate.

Additionally, when Elaine is attacked with a magical attack, dispels 1 debuff each from all allies enhanced with [Spirit Brand]. If this skill activates from the
7th turn and onwards, or if Elaine is defeated by the attack, this skill’s effect that dispels 1 debuff each from all allies enhanced with [Spirit Brand] when Elaine is attacked with a magical attack will not activate.
The amount the attacked ally’s HP is restored by becomes equal to 400% of Elaine’s ATK.

By chasing after an impossible wish, Elaine has fallen from grace, turning into The Witch of Lamented Spirits. At the start of the battle, this skill increases the DEF,
M. DEF, and M. CRIT DMG Cut of Elaine and the ally with the highest ATK, each by 10% for 6 turns (cannot be dispelled).
Additionally, at the start of the battle, decreases the damage Elaine takes by 10% (cannot be dispelled).
The decrease in damage she takes becomes 60%.
